responsibility: Contains late RTL peephole2 optimizations for RISC-V that are easier to express after instruction selection than in generic combine. The file rewrites small instruction sequences into shorter or more target-specific forms, notably simplifying certain RV64 shift patterns and merging adjacent load/store pairs into XTheadMemPair parallel forms, so it serves as a narrow cleanup layer on top of the main machine description rather than defining primary instruction patterns.
